blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. on Tuesday announced that Social Security System President and Chief Executive Officer Robert Joseph Montes de Claro is the new secretary of the Department of Information and Communications Technology. De Claro will replace Henry Aguda, whose resignation was confirmed by Marcos in a press briefing over the weekend.
